visual_reconciliation.method: All 50 main-guideline pages and all 159 data-supplement pages were rendered and visually scanned; load-bearing Figures 1-6 and the summary-of-findings table series were reconciled against the text layer.
visual_reconciliation.embedded_images_in_final_html: not required; decision logic and quantitative values are represented as structured HTML

coverage_decision: Atomize the guideline's independently reviewable formal guidance, definitions, implementation details, methods, and research recommendations. Use the data supplement for evidence reconciliation rather than treating trial results summarized by KDIGO as primary-study results.
omissions_and_reasons: Work Group biographies and financial-disclosure details were inspected but not atomized because they do not change the clinical guidance.
Individual rows from all 70 summary-of-findings tables were not converted into primary-study atoms because the guideline is a secondary source and did not generate those trial results.
The bibliography was extracted separately as provenance infrastructure rather than atomized.
